title: He Taught Me How to Walk
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler whose love shows up in slow, gentle holding, and tonight Hosea shows the Lord teaching Ephraim to walk by holding them by the arms. Kneeling on the rug, giving her baby cousin both her hands and walking slowly backward while he tries again is exactly Willow’s kind of warmth.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because her love shows up in slow, gentle holding. In Willow’s world today: her baby cousin wobbled across the rug and plopped down hard. Willow did not laugh. She knelt, gave him both her hands, and walked slowly backward while he tried again. Just like Heavenly Father held Ephraim by the arms, Willow learned that love helps little steps feel safe.
